environment.browser: Codex in-app browser; exact engine version not captured
environment.build: npm run build + npm run preview

method: Real button clicks using browser automation; timings read from rendered DOM data-solver-runtime-ms / delivered-ms / ready-ms. One fresh-page solve then six random-board solves. No other benchmark ran concurrently.

timingDefinitions.delivered: solve click handler entry to caller result
timingDefinitions.ready: solve click handler entry to useLayoutEffect after result DOM commit

functionalChecks: Diagonal on/off works as a binary toggle.
Skyfall on/off; no-skyfall results display N+0.
Top10 slots show distinct found signatures; missing groups are not fabricated.
Selecting #3 3+0 / 2 steps updates stats; playback shows total 3 combos / 9 orbs / 2 steps.
Repeated identical request uses cache with distinct zero-core timing.
limitations: Seven samples are a smoke test, not a p99 service guarantee.
Random UI boards were not saved; exact UI workload replay is unavailable. Seeded core and oracle reports are separately reproducible.
DOM commit is not proof of physical screen paint.
No previous-version browser UI comparison; no cross-device claim.
